items.ar: سبحان الله
items.tr: Glory be to Allah.
items.translit: Subhanallah.

items.ar: الحمد لله
items.tr: All praise belongs to Allah.
items.translit: Alhamdu lillah.

items.ar: لا اله الا الله
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah.
items.translit: La ilaha illallah.

items.ar: الله أكبر
items.tr: Allah is greatest.
items.translit: Allahu akbar.

items.ar: رب اغفر لى
items.tr: My Lord, forgive me.
items.translit: Rabbighfir li.

items.ar: استغفر الله
items.tr: I seek Allah's forgiveness.
items.translit: Astaghfirullah.

items.ar: لا حول ولا قوة الا بالله
items.tr: There is no power or strength except through Allah.
items.translit: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

items.ar: اللهمّ إنك عفوٌّ تُحبُّ العفوَ فاعفُ عنّي
items.tr: O Allah, You are Afuww (Pardoning) and love pardon, so pardon me.
items.translit: Allahumma innaka Afuwwun tuhibbul-afwa fafu anni.

items.ar: اللهم صل وسلم وبارك على سيدنا محمد
items.tr: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, grant him peace and bestow blessings upon him.
items.translit: Allahumma salli wa sallim wa barik ala sayyidina Muhammad.

items.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده سبحان الله العظيم
items.tr: Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah, Al-Azim (the Magnificent).
items.translit: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, subhanallahil-Azim.

items.ar: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر
items.tr: Glory be to Allah; all praise belongs to Allah; none is worthy of worship except Allah; Allah is greatest.
items.translit: Subhanallah, walhamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar.

items.ar: أستغفر الله الذى لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم وأتوب إليه
items.tr: I seek forgiveness from Allah, none is worthy of worship except Him, Al-Hayy (the Ever-Living), Al-Qayyum (the Sustainer of all), and I repent to Him.
items.translit: Astaghfirullahal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilayh.

items.ar: لا اله الا انت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين
items.tr:
Full-verse context (21:87):
And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger[899] and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him.[900] And he called out within the darknesses,[901] "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
[899] At the disbelief of his people.
[900] Or "would not restrict him" in the belly of the fish.
[901] That of the night, of the sea, and of the fish's interior.
items.translit: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin

items.ar: سبحان الله وبحمده عدد خلقه ورضا نفسه وزنة عرشه ومداد كلماته
items.tr: Glory and praise be to Allah, as numerous as His creation, to His own satisfaction, as weighty as His Throne, and as abundant as the ink of His words.
items.translit: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, adada khalqih, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata arshih, wa midada kalimatih.

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك، وله الحمدُ، وهو على كل شيء قدير
items.tr: None is worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.
items.translit: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shayin qadir.
